QUANTITY x PRICE COLUMNS AND A SPLIT CARD SLIP. Each line prints 'n x unit' in a middle column and the line total at the left edge; the line total is the amount (2 x 12.00 = 24.00, never 12.00, never 48.00). Below, a card slip shows 'שולם באשראי 86.00' — half the bill, one diner's share — and 'יתרה לתשלום 86.00'. Neither is the receipt's total; 172.00 is. The same trap as the real DejaVoo receipt, where the model took a card slip's 90.00 as the total.

Generated by scripts/fixtures/make-hebrew-receipts.py — a clean Hebrew receipt in an ordinary Israeli POS layout, photographed-style (slight tilt, shadow, JPEG). No personal data: business, address and ח.פ. are made up. Exists so a Hebrew failure can be told apart from faded or creased paper, which is what most of the real Hebrew fixtures are. Israeli prices include VAT, so the 'כולל מע"מ 18%' line is information, never a charge: taxAmount must be null.
